TYPE CONVERSION IN ACTION
1. Parsing Input (String to Decimal): • Decimal.Parse(txtIn.Text) extracts numbers from raw text. • Preserves exact decimal precision (ideal for currency). 2. Explicit Conversion (Narrowing / Casting): • Convert.ToInt32() forces conversion into a 32-bit Integer. • Fractional values round automatically to the nearest whole integer. 3. Implicit Conversion (Widening): • Assigns a narrower type (Integer) to a wider type (Double). • Handled automatically by VB.NET without data loss.
